contradictions.why: This is a round trip that starts and ends at the same trailhead, so total gain and total loss must be equal — but gain_ft (6120) and loss_ft (9500) differ by 3,380 ft, which is physically impossible for a loop. contradictions.why: Waypoints, overview and pitch_detail all confidently identify the WEST summit as the true 8,240 ft high point with the east summit lower. The itinerary's own summit-day schedule reverses this, calling the EAST summit the 'true' summit and the 8,240 ft high point, while giving the west summit only ~8,200 ft. The baseFinding text explicitly flags that the route's own sources disagree on which summit is higher, confirming this is a real, acknowledged inconsistency in the underlying data rather than a simple typo.
